policies: Decimal strings preserve reported digits; they do not make physical measurements exact.
Uncertainty magnitude, statistical convention, distribution and covariance are distinct.
NUBASE systematics/tentative markers remain visible; an absent source does not imply absent physical data.
Element-reference A selections remain inherited unresolved choices, not standard atomic weights.
Bulk-material properties require material/phase/temperature/pressure identity and are outside this atom/isotope catalog.

properties.definition: CIAAW standard atomic weight for normal materials, with interval where specified; distinct from isotope mass and sample composition.
Ground-state electronic configuration, isotope unspecified unless explicitly assigned.
Ground-state term and angular momentum designation with source qualifiers.
Minimum energy to remove an electron from the stated charge-state ground state; q0 and q1 give first and second ionization separately.
Energy released on attachment to the stated neutral ground state; positive denotes bound anion under the declared source convention.
Selected electronic level energy relative to the specified spectrum ground state.
Selected observed or Ritz wavelength, with medium and transition retained.
State-, frequency- and tensor-component-specific atomic polarizability in the explicitly stated source convention.
Specified transition frequency response to magnetic field; sublevels, field regime and order required.
Specified transition quadratic electric-field response; sublevels, field regime and order required.
Neutral-atom atomic mass from AME2020; not bare nuclear mass and not standard atomic weight.
AME2020 neutral-atom mass excess relative to A atomic mass units.
AME2020 reported binding energy per nucleon, retaining evaluation/systematics markers.
A times the AME2020 binding energy per nucleon; exact multiplication of the reported decimal.
ME(Z,A-1)+ME(neutron)-ME(Z,A), neutral-atom mass-excess convention; joint input covariance not supplied.
ME(Z-1,A-1)+ME(H-1)-ME(Z,A), neutral-atom mass-excess convention; electron binding corrections not separately reconstructed.
ME(parent)-ME(daughter)-ME(He-4), neutral-atom mass-excess convention. A positive Q does not establish an observed decay branch.
AME2020 reported beta-minus energy with its source uncertainty; sign is retained.
NUBASE nuclear spin/parity designation; tentative parentheses, direct-measurement * and systematics # remain visible.
NUBASE verbatim decay-mode/intensity record; not normalized into unsupported probabilities.
NUBASE source-reported abundance qualification; not a universal sample composition.
State-specific nuclear magnetic dipole moment; no spin-only inferred value.
State-specific nuclear electric quadrupole moment.
State-specific root-mean-square nuclear charge radius.
Energy of the named isomer relative to its stated ground-state endpoint; candidate assignments remain tentative.
Ground-state hyperfine separation with explicit isotope, electronic state and reference dependence.
Frequency difference for one stated electronic transition between two explicit isotope/state endpoints, retaining sign convention.
